label: a2
method: Single float64 weighted sum of trained parameters, rounded once
rationale: R11 and its R12 continuation use the same strong teacher objective and original training mixture. They each miss the larger multilingual mean by about 0.008 points while passing English and every larger individual guard. Their sole development failures differ: Finnish for R11, Latvian for R12. Test direct averages with R12 shares of 35%, 50%, 65%, retaining the fixed fits and unchanged buffers. This is adaptive recovery on exposed regressions; neither WER nor qualification is assumed to interpolate between the parents.
selection_rule: Audit and evaluate all three development candidates. Test development-passing candidates on the larger regression in increasing development-WER order, stopping at the first full pass. If none passes development, run the lowest-development-WER candidate once for diagnosis only. Preserve every result and explicitly name any larger comparisons not run.
